# T16 — Project baseline (retrospective, 2026-11-23)

## Scope

The frozen scope baseline `01a20a84-b302-7bc0-a542-03eca40ca384` (kind `scope`, taken
2026-11-23T22:26:38Z, frozen) covers six deliverables, each with its four WSJF inputs:

| # | Deliverable | Business value | Time criticality | Risk reduction | Job size |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | SOP intake as a governed asset: procedures.ingest_sop produces capability and job drafts | 9 | 8 | 6 | 3 |
| 2 | RDF/OWL/Turtle imported as a strata knowledge pack bound by knowledge_pack_ref | 8 | 7 | 5 | 2 |
| 3 | BPMN, Visio and draw.io converted into PDDL procedure drafts | 9 | 8 | 6 | 3 |
| 4 | Source review and human publication gates: the drafting job cannot publish its own procedure | 9 | 7 | 7 | 2 |
| 5 | Re-ingest versioning keeps the published row's source and pack | 8 | 6 | 6 | 2 |
| 6 | A bound job runs the PDDL steps; an unreviewed source never binds | 8 | 7 | 6 | 2 |

The baseline gate froze this scope; the WBS rows were then accepted under the approved change
`Accept the T16 deliverables with their evidence`.

## Schedule

No schedule baseline row exists for T16. The project is delivered inside tranche 4 per SPEC_V2
§12, and the tranche-4 review is its schedule record. Recorded as an explicit absence, not a
silent gap.

## Cost

No cost baseline row exists for T16. Programme cost is the business case's quantified appraisal
(MSP); this project's cost is therefore not separately baselined. Recorded as an explicit absence.

## Approval

The scope baseline was approved by `01a1e8a7-8b23-76a9-9114-aafb95f7a545`, distinct from its taker
`01a1e607-17d9-77d3-98d3-a43a87c4633d`, at 2026-11-23T22:26:38Z. The baseline gate is approved, and
the close gate named it.
